talkwheel.jaymoskingdoms.jaymoskingdoms_: I'll let you get on. Take care.
talk_end.jaymoskingdoms.goodbye.gentle.0: Take care of yourself, %1$s. Come by again.

talk_end.jaymoskingdoms.goodbye.timid.1: Yes, of course. Mind how you go.
talk_end.jaymoskingdoms.goodbye.odd.0: Goodbye, %1$s. I'll tell the crows you said hello.
talk_end.jaymoskingdoms.goodbye.odd.1: Off you go. Mind the gaps between the stones.
talk_end.jaymoskingdoms.goodbye.child.0: Bye! Come back and play later!
talk_end.jaymoskingdoms.bored.gentle.0: Well, I'd best get back to it, %1$s. We'll talk again.
talk_end.jaymoskingdoms.bored.gentle.1: Listen to me go on. I really must get on, %1$s.
talk_end.jaymoskingdoms.bored.sharp.0: That's enough talk for me. I've things to do.
talk_end.jaymoskingdoms.bored.sharp.1: Are we done? Good. I'm busy.
talk_end.jaymoskingdoms.bored.timid.0: I-I should really get back now. Sorry.
talk_end.jaymoskingdoms.bored.timid.1: That's... a lot of talking. I need a moment to myself.
talk_end.jaymoskingdoms.bored.odd.0: My thoughts have wandered off. I'd better go and find them.
talk_end.jaymoskingdoms.bored.odd.1: That's all the words I had for today. Goodbye.
talk_end.jaymoskingdoms.bored.child.0: This is boring. I'm going to go play.
talk_end.jaymoskingdoms.bored.child.1: Grown-up talk is so long. Bye!
